## Problem and related issues

Related issue: #

Use `Fixes #123` only after verifying the issue's reproduction is resolved. An opened or failed PR must not close an issue.

## Proposed solution and affected code paths

Explain relevant callers, error handling, and why the change is correct.

## Validation and regression evidence

Commands/results, before/after behavior, and added or updated tests. Explain missing coverage rather than claiming tests passed.

## Compatibility and risk

Public API / serialization / package identity changes, migrations, security implications, dependency licenses, and rollback considerations.

## UI and performance (where applicable)

Keyboard/screen-reader results, screenshots, and representative performance measurements.

## Release notes

User-facing changes, removed functionality, and breaking changes.

- [ ] No credentials or unredacted personal data included.
- [ ] Required validation passes; failures were fixed rather than bypassed.
- [ ] A human maintainer will review this PR; automation must not approve its own changes.
